# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

**Do not open a public GitHub issue for security vulnerabilities.**

Email: security@baryon.live
Subject line: `[SECURITY] Baryon — brief description`

Please include:

- Description of the vulnerability
- Steps to reproduce
- Potential impact
- Any suggested fix (optional)

We will acknowledge receipt within 48 hours and aim to release a patch within
14 days for confirmed vulnerabilities. We will credit reporters in the release
notes unless you prefer to remain anonymous.
